Dialogs.Dialog: Takane
Hey, have you ever been to the New Year's firefighter parade？
Firefighter... what's that again？ Not the first calligraphy of the year？
Geez, totally different. The parade is a fire department event, you know？
Ah, was it？
Like the ladder acrobatics... Don't you think it looks fun？
You're curious about it, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
It's a traditional event...
Forget tradition, you just want to try climbing the ladder, right！
...Huh？
...Hmph.
(Don't tell me I hit the mark？)
Takane
For the Coming of Age Ceremony, I wonder if a kimono is best after all.
Hm？ What's this, all of a sudden？
I heard from a girl in the neighborhood who agonized over a furisode or a suit.
Which would you want to see？
Hmm, either one.
...Ah！ I didn't mean it like that！ I mean they're both great, I want to see both, really！
...Hehe. Geez.
That wasn't very smooth, but I'll forgive you. Let's go to the ceremony together, okay？
Yes, of course！
Takane
Have you ever had a serious snowball fight？
Serious... you mean like a capture-the-flag game？
Yes. You can't win without careful strategy and leadership. Sounds fun, right？
Don't worry, I'm not saying let's join right away？
Haha, right.
We have to research it and practice properly first, right？
Huh？
Let's do our best, okay？
(...So I'm definitely in？)
Takane
The sky is so pretty this time of year, isn't it？
Yeah. Different from summer... sort of "kaan," or "kiin."
Hm？
Um... is this where I continue with "kuun"？
Close. A little cuter, like a puppy. Go！
K... Kuuun？
Ah...
You're teasing me again. Hmph.
(Rabbits are nice, but puppies aren't bad either...)
Takane
Sumo's really heating up, isn't it？
Oh, you're following it？
Of course. On days I'm late, I ask them to record it, and until then I make sure I don't hear the results.
Right, if you know who won before watching the bout, it's half as fun.
Right. Papa and I had a fight over that once.
Huh？ What do you mean？
Because the moment I got home, he said with a big smile, "He won, Manaka！"
Ah, he must have been really happy.
I cried, and didn't come out of my room for a while.
(Your dad must have panicked...)
Takane
There's a really pretty flowering peach blooming in the garden across the street.
Flowering peach？
There are two kinds of peach, you know？ Fruit peaches for eating, and flowering peaches for looking at.
Huh. So that one doesn't bear fruit？
It does get tiny ones... Are you curious？
I thought maybe you're the curious one, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Well, if they're not for eating, you wouldn't eat them！
▲Takane＊＊▲？
The neighbor across the street did say they're not exactly inedible, but...
...Yes.
(She wanted to try them...)
Takane
A little relative of mine？ He just started kindergarten.
Huh, you have a relative that little.
They sent me photos of the entrance ceremony, and he's sooo cute...
A relative, so does he look like you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
No. He's a boy, after all.
He says he's going to marry me when he grows up.
...Huh, how typical.
Nothing～.
Hehe. "Huh, how typical," he says！ That kind of makes me happy.
Takane
"Hanabie," the chill during cherry blossom season, is such a pretty word, isn't it？
It does sound nice... but it's not very kind to your body.
But I'm kind of happy about it.
Why？
...Because I can say to you, "It's cold, my hands are cold," right？
...It's getting a little chilly, isn't it？
...Here.
Okay▼
Takane
I wonder what I should do on Mother's Day...
What do you do each year？
Carnations, and one handmade thing.
Huh, handmade.
I don't have a part-time job, and besides, things that cost money don't make her happy.
Handmade's great. Like what？
Usually sewing, small things she can use every day... Sometimes I make really elaborate sweets.
That's amazing...
Making it is fun, but deciding what to make is hard.
Since it's every year, huh.
Right. There's her birthday too, so I run out of ideas fast. That's why I train every day♪
(Lucky mom.)
By the way, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, didn't you say you were buying tea？
Takane
Yes. Darjeeling is at its best this season.
Tea has a season？
Yes, indeed it does.
Oh, a tea lesson from you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Darjeeling has the best taste and aroma in May and June. After that, the aroma fades.
Ceylon is in season in July and August. There are lots of teas to enjoy, you know？
Huh. I want to try enjoying it too.
Then next time, I'll serve you an especially delicious tea, just for you▼
Does the Takane family do anything for Father's Day？
Takane
Of course. We always have flowers ready, you know？
And a booklet of 10 shoulder massage coupons. Divided by body part, all handmade.
By body part？ That's serious.
Actually, I've thought about giving a bag or a tie...
But he says that won't do. So it's been the same since I was little.
I think I'll keep doing it even when I grow up... No, I want to keep doing it.
...Just saying.
(Her dad must be happy every year.)
Takane
Speaking of June...
What？
What do you think？
Oh, a quiz. Let's see... the rainy season？
Bzzt.
Shareholder meetings！
Nope.
The pain of having no holidays！
Incorrect.
Strike out... Hint！
It's embarrassing to say... it's beautiful and nice... it's a girl's dream▼
(A dream... Ah, June brides.)
Takane
I really want to eat physalis.
Huh？
Ah, not like that！ There's an edible kind called strawberry tomato that's in season now...
Oh... it's different from the ones you see around？
No way, you can't eat those. They're bitter and give you a stomachache.
Hm？
...Or so I've heard？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is really... adventurous, or something...)
Takane
Sigh...
What's up？
Ah, sorry. I was thinking about the summer gifts.
Summer gifts？ Why the sigh？
We get so many every year, and Mama and I are swamped making the list.
That many？
Papa and Mama know a lot of people... Isn't there some good way？
Hmm...
If you think of one, I'm sure it'll come in handy someday, you know？
You think？
Of course, I'll help too.
Takane
It's hot today too, isn't it？
Yeah... I wish we'd get an evening shower.
Yes...
Ah, you know？ When I was little, I thought it was called "yuudachi" because it rains in the evening.
Huh, it's not？
The kanji are just borrowed for the sound. If you look up the origin, it's even more interesting, you know？
So you're not going to tell me right now？
Isn't it more memorable if you look it up yourself instead of just asking？
Haha, you sound like a teacher.
▲主人公＊▲.
Yes！
Make sure you do your homework！
(If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ really were my teacher, I'd be motivated...)
Takane
Obon lanterns are pretty, aren't they？
Ah, the ones that spin around from the heat？
Yes. When I was little, they had them at Grandmother's house...
I was curious how it worked, and tried to put my hand inside, but it was a candle――
Whoa！ Were you hurt!?
I was fine, thankfully. But they replaced it with an electric one right away.
Well, of course...
Even now, when I get near an Obon lantern, everyone stops me, you know？ I'm not a kid anymore.
(I kind of get why they'd want to...)
Hm？
No, it's nothing！
Autumn, huh. Come to think of it, the seven autumn flowers...
Takane
Can you name them all？
Hmm...
Hagi, obana, kuzu, nadeshiko, ominaeshi, fujibakama, kikyo... Go.
Hagi, Obana, Kuzu... Uh？
Do your best to memorize them, okay？
Hmm...
Seri, Nazuna, Gogyo, Hakobe, Hotokenoza, Suzuna, Suzushiro.
Huh？
Those are the seven spring herbs, so don't mix them up.
(That just makes it more confusing！)
Takane
There were mackerel clouds out.
And just a while ago there were big thunderheads.
Soon the fragrant olive will bloom, and there'll be a lovely smell――
When that happens, it means fall is truly here.
Right. Can't stay in summer mode forever！
You were still in summer mode？
Ah, yes. Well...
Geez, let's wait for next year？
Haha, right.
Takane
Have you finished switching out your clothes for the season？
What about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
All done. I do it together with my school uniform.
That might be a good idea...
Which means you haven't done it, have you？
...I wonder.
Geez. But it's okay. You're fine just the way you are.
Someday, I'll properly――
Hm？
...Until then, don't let anyone else touch them. Promise.
When did Halloween get big in Japan, I wonder？ It seems pretty recent.
Takane
The first time I was in a Halloween costume parade was my first year of kindergarten, so...
What costume did you wear？ A witch？
...Pumpkin.
...Pumpkin？
I don't remember it, though？
Apparently I cried because I absolutely wanted to wear the big jack-o'-lantern Mama made...
Huh, then...
Even if you say you want to see it, no. ...It's embarrassing.
Yeah, yeah！ That's exactly why I want to see it！
...Hmph.
(I said the wrong thing...)
Takane
It's new soba season.
Did I say something strange...？
I was just thinking you know when everything's in season, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
When you like something, you want to know more about it, right？
I see... Oh, was it like that with me too？
Eh... Geez.
But, maybe...
Hmm, I see.
...Geez, how did we end up talking about this？ We were talking about soba.
Takane
I found the first frost.
Oh. Did you step on it？
Yes. Crunch, crunch▼
Frost, huh. Snow might be soon？
I want to see the first snow with you.
Yeah, I hope we can.
Then we have to make an effort so we can.
Effort, how？
Being together as much as possible. That raises the odds, right？
I see. That could apply to lots of things.
Right, so being together all the time is the correct answer. Hehe.
Takane
I need to order buckwheat flour soon.
For New Year's Eve soba... Does your family make it by hand, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes. Papa's soba is delicious, you know.
Your dad makes it！
It's the real deal, you know？ The neighbors love it, so we make it every year.
I make it with him, but Papa's always tastes better. It's almost frustrating.
Lucky...
I'd like to share some with you▼
(Yes！)
Brr, cold！
Takane
At times like this, you want to warm up in the bath, right？ Like a yuzu bath.
Sounds nice. But I know a warmer way？
What's that？
Come here, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Huh？
That wouldn't make me warm, it'd make me hot.
So I'll make do with a yuzu bath.
(You don't have to make do！)
Did you watch any New Year's specials？
Takane
I watched a period drama with a relative of mine. A little boy.
Huh. I wonder if kids find period dramas interesting.
He was so excited. Afterwards I had to be his sword-fighting partner. It was exhausting, you know？
You, sword fighting, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes. With rolled-up newspaper, the two of us going "Hyah！ Yah！"
I see...
Ah, stop it. You were imagining it just now, weren't you？
Haha. That's cool, Swordswoman Manaka.
No, I was the one who gets beaten. But when I tried really hard to act defeated, he believed it and started crying...
(She's serious about even that, huh...)
What's the Takane family's osechi like？
Takane
What's it like？ Normal, you know？ When the ingredients we ordered arrive, we prep them, and start cooking around when the pine decorations go up...
That already doesn't sound normal... It's all homemade？
Yes. Mama makes the main ones, but I'm in charge of a few too. Vinegared turnip, nishiki eggs, and chestnut kinton.
Huh, amazing. Isn't osechi hard to make？
Not really. Each one is no different from regular cooking. There are just so many that it takes a long time.
It seems Papa used to help too. Now that I'm here, he works hard on the year-end cleaning instead.
Your family does everything together, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Celebrations are something everyone does together, right？ So everyone has to help prepare, too.
(That's nice...)
Takane
It's fun to go out to the garden and see the first signs of spring.
Like tree buds, or flower buds？
Yes, yes. And birds too. Bush warblers, white-eyes...
The warblers are here already？
Yes. There's a feeder in a tree in the garden, and they come to it. There's not much food in winter, so it's busy every day.
Mostly sparrows and pigeons, but the troublemakers are the bulbuls. They're big, so everyone gets scared and flies away.
I see. Then the bulbuls must be lonely with no friends, poor things.
▲Takane＊＊▲？
When you think of it that way, they're poor things. I have to stop shooing them away...
(She was shooing them away...)
Takane
Both the white and red plum trees in the neighborhood are at their best. They're really magnificent trees.
White and red, huh. Feels festive.
Hehe, I think the same thing every time I pass by.
And then I always remember the red-and-white curtains at entrance ceremonies, then red-and-white gym caps, and finally red-and-white manju.
...An association game？
Maybe. So now whenever I see those plums, I think they look delicious...
Haha, dumplings over flowers.
It's just those plums. I don't usually do that.
And it's not dumplings over flowers, it's flowers and dumplings. I picture both together, so neither one wins, right？
(That's what she's particular about...)
Spring is finally here.
Takane
That's right. It's getting a lot warmer lately.
And I'm getting sleepy...
Isn't that because you don't get enough sleep？
Spring's just like that.
It's the season of waking from hibernation. You should be waking up instead. Right？
But isn't waking up when you're sleepiest？ "Five more minutes～." So spring's sleepy after all.
Geez, always saying things like that. Mr. Excuses.
(You're no slouch at arguing either, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
Takane
More people are wearing masks.
It's pollen season.
The patients who come to our clinic all have red eyes and noses, poor things. I wish there were a cure for hay fever.
By the time we're grown up, it might be invented.
Right. Maybe I'll be the one to invent it？ ...Just kidding.
Ooh, go for it, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. That's Nobel Prize material.
Geez, you're teasing me. I'm a little bit serious, you know.
I'm not teasing. If you get serious, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, I'll seriously cheer you on.
Just cheer？ You won't do it with me？
That's... I guess I could try？
We haven't chosen our paths yet. The possibilities are wide open, you know？
(She's serious...)
I wonder if any of the new shows are interesting.
Takane
The late-night sports news. The content got really good.
It got revamped？
Yes. It's news, but it's easy to get into like a variety show, and it covers lots of minor sports, so there's tons of info.
Whoa, you're really pushing it.
And it has a sumo corner, you know？ Even when there's no tournament, you can see practice scenes and wrestler features.
Huh... A show made just for you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Except it starts at 10 at night... I wish it were a little earlier.
10 is within reason, isn't it？
No. It's an hour long, so I'm sleepy by the second half. On days when the sumo corner is in the second half, I might have to record it.
(Even a sumo fan can't beat sleepiness...)
Takane
It's outing season.
Hm, are you hinting for a date？
Eh... I didn't mean it like that.
Haha, kidding.
Geez... But yes, taking a lunch to the park... Ah.
What's wrong？
The park's nice, but I love our garden too. On days off, the three of us have lunch in the garden.
Huh, nice.
If you'd like, I'd love to invite you.
Um... that's, well, you know？
Nervous being with Papa and Mama？ Then, just the two of us...
(Then her parents would just be watching us from inside...)
Takane
Lots of frogs will be coming out soon.
...Why do you look so happy？
Frogs are cute, aren't they？ I like the little green ones. Their croaks are cute too.
I thought all girls hated them.
All girls like cute things.
I don't think many girls think frogs are cute...
That's not true. Geez, you don't understand girls at all.
Then teach me？
I won't teach you that easily. Besides, I think that's something you have to understand on your own.
(Sounds like what a craftsman would say...)
Takane
Hey, kashiwa mochi is really easy to make, you know.
Ah, it's that season... You can make those yourself？
Yes. I shared them with the neighbors, so there's none left, though...
I see, that's a pity...
Sorry. I'll make some for you again when I get the chance. What color would you like？
Huh, aren't they white？
Just white is a little plain, so I made them colorful. Green with mugwort, pink with food coloring, yellow with turmeric...
The kids loved them, and asked me to make them again.
Huh, so you can do that. You're amazing, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
It's really not a big deal.
(And she's being genuinely modest...)
Takane
This time of year, it's already pretty bright out by around 4.
You're up at that hour？
I just happened to wake up. I thought it was morning, looked at the clock, and it was 4. It surprised me.
I'm still dreaming at that hour...
Me too, usually. But it's a waste to sleep when it's light out. Maybe I'll go to bed a little earlier and wake up a little earlier...
Huh, you're going to bed even earlier？
...Is that bad？
Not bad. I just thought you already go to bed early enough.
You're right. I want to match your schedule as much as I can... Maybe I'll keep things as they are.
Takane
The laundry won't dry. It's such a pain.
It's the rainy season. There are some sunny spells, but...
Even when the sun's out, it's so humid.
Just toss it in the dryer.
You can't put delicate clothes in. Depends on the fabric, and things with embroidery or lace.
Then the dry cleaner's.
You can't send out things you wash every day.
Tough one.
Isn't it a pain for you？
Me... well, I wing it.
Geez... Looks like I should've worried about you before my own house.
Hahaha...
Takane
By the way... do you know what Marine Day is for？
Well, it's Marine Day.
Not that... I mean, what you do on that day, and what it's for.
Well... it's to thank the sea.
Thank the sea... for fish, and salt？
And for couples, beach trips！
There you go, making things up again... But you're right. We should be thankful.
Right, right. Thanks to it, we get one more date spot. So it's all good.
Geez... Fine, let's say that's the case.
Takane
Hey, which do you like better, morning glories or hydrangeas？
To grow？
No, I mean yukata patterns. Grandmother's going to make a new one.
Oh yeah？ That's great.
Yes. I narrowed it down to two out of lots of patterns... I thought I'd go with the one you like.
That's a big responsibility... But if you can't decide, why not have her make both？
No way. That'd be too much work for Grandmother.
She'd do it for her cute granddaughter. There's no way she could refuse your request, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Eh... ah, sorry. Um... it's not mine, it's a yukata for a little relative of mine.
Huh？
I'm sorry.
(Nothing to apologize for... but I'm a little disappointed.)
Takane
The first day of autumn is coming up.
Even though it's midsummer... After the first day of autumn, summer greetings become late-summer greetings, right？
Yes. So you have to be careful about timing when you reply to people who sent you summer greetings.
I see. If you're late, a summer greeting won't do.
Huh？
You know. Papa is very particular about that kind of etiquette.
Hm？ Yeah.
Mama... not so much, but on Mama's side of the family, lots of people value etiquette...
Huh, I see. Maybe I should learn that kind of thing too？
Ah！！
Huh？
Yes, I think you should learn it. So, let's study？ Um, to prepare for the future.
(Why is ▲高嶺＊＊▲ so happy？)
Want me to help with your summer homework？
Takane
Eh!?
Haha, just wanted to try saying that for once. Surprised？
Geez. I panicked, thinking I'd forgotten something.
...You're already done？
Yes. I can't fully enjoy vacation with you until I've finished my homework.
Huh... I haven't even...
...Um, want me to help？ Are you okay？
(So it ends up like this...)
Autumn's really here. It's your season, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Takane
Me？ Why？
You love sports, you're a great cook... and you read, right, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Hehe, by that logic, lots of people fit.
True, but. For me, I want to make the most of autumn as the season of food.
You'll cook？ Ah, maybe you're thinking of learning seriously.
No, no, the eating part.
...What？ You've got eyes full of expectation.
Well, I'm just thinking how lucky I am to have a girlfriend who's a great cook.
Geez, such a smooth talker... All right, what would you like me to make for you？
(Yay！)
Takane
Papa's going to go help out at an animal hospital.
Huh？ Isn't your dad a doctor for people, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
A friend of his is holding an Animal Welfare Week event, so he's helping.
Oh, that's what it is. What's the event？
A petting area, a dog training class, and a picture-card show for kids, I think. There'll be guide dog and hearing dog demonstrations too.
Huh, sounds serious.
Right. Hey, want to sneak in, just the two of us？
Sure, but why sneak？
Papa says we can't come. He's doing the picture-card show, and he says it's embarrassing to have me or Mama watch. Why, I wonder？
(I think I understand... It's better if I don't go.)
Takane
The shopping mall has great offers right now.
Huh, you check that stuff too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Um...
Hm？
Actually, I just heard about it from a friend... I don't really know.
Haha, oh. And here I thought you sounded like a normal high school girl for once, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
I am a normal high school girl！
Huh, even though you didn't know how to order a burger？
Ah, geez！ Meanie！
Takane
Do you know how Sports Day came to be Sports Day？
Because it's autumn！
Bzzt.
Because it's autumn, the sports season！
Nope.
Sports of the autumn！
Hehehe, what's that？ Incorrect.
I give up... What's the answer？
Hehe. You know... huh？
Hm？
Geez, you made me laugh so I forgot. Let's save this for next time, okay？
(Now I'm curious...)
Takane
The daffodils in the garden have begun to bloom. They are early this year.
When do they usually bloom again？
Winter to spring, I think. The buds start to swell after the first day of winter.
Um... when's the first day of winter again？
Early November, the 7th or 8th, around then.
Huh... You really know everything, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Not at all. I just know about flowers because I like them, and I thought I should learn the calendar if I want to be a doctor.
Doctors and the calendar are related？
Lots of illnesses are related to the seasons. And herbal medicines made from seasonal ingredients are closely tied to plants, right？
...You really know everything, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Thank you. This time, I'll just accept that.
Some people in my class were absent. Looks like the flu's already going around.
Takane
And the school vaccinations haven't even happened yet... At our clinic, there's a line of patients every day.
I see, so it's your dad's busy season, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Especially these past few years. Papa used to go out to nearby nursery schools and elementary schools too, but now he doesn't have time.
So that many more patients？
I think people are more careful about the flu. That's not a bad thing, but...
...But？
I'm worried Papa might collapse from being too busy.
I see. I hope it passes soon...
Takane
We got lots of pumpkins. I wonder what to make.
Pumpkins？
A patient brought some to share for the winter solstice. People eat pumpkin then, right？
Ah, the winter solstice. Huh, maybe I'll have some pumpkin soup too.
That's good. Okay, one dish is pumpkin soup, decided.
Why not a pumpkin full course？ Pumpkin from start to finish.
The main dish would be... No wait, hollow out a pumpkin, and in the pumpkin bowl, stir-fry pumpkin and meat...
(I was kidding...)
Yes, I can do it. Let's make a pumpkin full course！
(If it's ▲高嶺＊＊▲, she really could...)
Takane
It's year-end cleaning season. I wonder where to start.
Whoa, you're fired up.
Thinking about all the things I have to do makes me kind of excited. And it's fun watching the house get cleaner and cleaner.
Yep, you'll make a great wife, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Ah... geez, no. Being a good wife isn't just about cleaning.
You can cook, you're thoughtful, you're kind. You're perfect, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Huh？
If you say things like that, I'll work even harder at housework.
